'''Masaki Terasoma''' (Japanese: '''てらそままさき''' ''Terasoma Masaki'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}. He is often credited under the name '''Masanori Jisen'''. Apart from being a voice actor, he is also a TV actor specially for the role of {{wp|Kamen Rider Agito}}. He was born on May 8, 1962 in {{wp|Osaka}}, {{wp|Japan}}.

==Biography==
Terasoma started out his work in {{aniseries|PTS}} by voicing {{OBP|J's client|DP071}}. He later provided his voice for [[Drayden]]. However, his most prominent role was [[Looker]] in {{aniseries|DP}} and {{aniseries|BW}}.
